g.text: Proposed; business entities are not implemented
Invited: no name or credentials yet.
Active is an account state, not a session.
Each external login belongs to one Account.
1 = exactly one; 0..1 = optional; 0..* = zero or more; 1..* = one or more.
Incident -> Resource is optional in the current proposal; final scope is open.
HistoryEntry may have no Account (system or unattributed change).
Reservation, Loan, Incident, HistoryEntry, Notification remain provisional.
Attribute nodes are scoped to their owner: Status is not one shared lifecycle.
Loan delivery/return timestamps are absent until those events occur.
Aggregate boundaries are proposals, not an accepted consequence of ADR-002.
Cross-aggregate arrows express associations, not ownership or cascade deletion.
